subject: maths
question: If 8 men can do a piece of work in 14 days, the time taken by 12 men to do the same piece of work will be:
solution:
**Given:**

8 men can complete the work in 14 days.

12 men need to complete the same work.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Men × Days

Men × Days (initial) = Men × Days (final)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work by 8 men in 14 days = Work by 12 men in x days

⇒ 8 × 14 = 12 × x

⇒ 112 = 12x

⇒ x = 112 ÷ 12

⇒ x = 9.33 days

**∴ The correct answer is 9.33 days.**
